/* Pixel Arcade avatar guide: same characters as the hub avatar creator (profile.js above). */
function paLoadAvatar(){try{var r=localStorage.getItem('pa.profile.v1');if(r)return JSON.parse(r)}catch(e){}return null}
function paAvatar(){return paLoadAvatar()||{name:'Curator',skinHex:'#f5c28f',hairStyle:'bun',hairHex:'#5a3215',outfitHex:'#8a3ffc',outfitStyle:4,accentHex:'#ffd23f',eyeHex:'#14102c',eyes:0,mouth:0,accessory:'none',extras:{}}}
function paPixelSvg(p,scale,attrs,olc){var g=PAProfile.pixelGrid(PAProfile.clean(p)),GW=24,GH=28,ol=1,oc=olc||'#466391';function at(x,y){return (x>=0&&x<GW&&y>=0&&y<GH)?g[y][x]:null}var r='';
 for(var y=-1;y<=GH;y++)for(var x=-1;x<=GW;x++){if(at(x,y))continue;if(at(x-1,y)||at(x+1,y)||at(x,y-1)||at(x,y+1))r+='<rect x="'+x+'" y="'+y+'" width="1" height="1" fill="'+oc+'"/>'}
 for(var y2=0;y2<GH;y2++)for(var x2=0;x2<GW;x2++){var v=at(x2,y2);if(v)r+='<rect x="'+x2+'" y="'+y2+'" width="1" height="1" fill="'+v+'"/>'}
 var W=GW+2*ol,H=GH+2*ol;
 return '<svg viewBox="'+(-ol)+' '+(-ol)+' '+W+' '+H+'" width="'+Math.round(W*scale)+'" height="'+Math.round(H*scale)+'" '+(attrs||'')+' style="image-rendering:pixelated;shape-rendering:crispEdges">'+r+'</svg>'}
function paPawn(){return paPixelSvg(paAvatar(),28/26,'aria-label="Your gallery guide"')}
function paName(){return PAProfile.load().name}
function curator(){return `<svg viewBox="0 0 280 180" role="img" aria-label="Your Pixel Arcade gallery guide"><rect x="9" y="9" width="262" height="162" rx="25" fill="#0c1732" stroke="#466391"/><path d="M52 126H91V155H52ZM187 55H231V126H187" stroke="#74d7ff" stroke-width="3" fill="#273a69"/><path d="M198 66 220 82 200 113" stroke="#80edbe" stroke-width="4"/>${paPixelSvg(paAvatar(),5,'x="75" y="15"')}<path d="M55 96V78M48 86H62" stroke="#74d7ff" stroke-width="3"/></svg>`}
function icon(type='museum'){return `<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 32 50 10 88 32H12ZM14 81H86M9 91H91" stroke="#80edbe" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M23 40V74M41 40V74M59 40V74M77 40V74" stroke="#74d7ff" stroke-width="7"/><circle cx="50" cy="27" r="4" fill="#b7a2ff"/></svg>`}
const PXART={"met": "", "louvre": "", "rijks": "", "detective": "", "workshop": "", "matching": "", "ladder": "", "timeline": "", "styletrail": "", "world": "","aic": "","cma": "","nga": ""};
function pxArt(k,label){return `<img class="illustration pxart" src="data:image/png;base64,${PXART[k]}" alt="${label}" width="160" height="80">`}
function museumArt(id){const N={met:'The Metropolitan Museum of Art facade',louvre:'The Louvre with its glass pyramid',rijks:'The Rijksmuseum',aic:'Art Institute of Chicago facade with lion statues',cma:'Cleveland Museum of Art facade',nga:'National Gallery of Art facade with dome'};return pxArt(PXART[id]?id:'met','Pixel-art illustration: '+(N[id]||'a museum facade'))}
function illustration(id,wide=false){let g=galleries[id],shape='';const t=g.name;
if(g.medium==='Architecture'){let roof=t==='Gothic'?'<path d="M30 100Q30 45 65 24Q100 45 100 100"/>':t.includes('Renaissance')?'<path d="M15 57 65 28 115 57ZM20 104H110M30 60V100M53 60V100M77 60V100M100 60V100"/>':t==='Art Deco'?'<path d="M35 108V70H45V50H55V30H75V50H85V70H95V108M55 65V100M75 65V100"/>':'<path d="M22 103V42H108V103ZM22 64H108M50 43V102M79 43V102"/>';shape=`<g transform="translate(73 5)" stroke="#80edbe" fill="#253a66" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round">${roof}</g>`}
else if(t==='Cubism'||t==='Geometric abstraction')shape='<path d="M72 20 130 35 93 96 44 71Z" fill="#74d7ff"/><path d="M130 35 215 23 232 100 142 115 93 96Z" fill="#b7a2ff"/><path d="M130 35V110M45 72 230 100" stroke="#122445" stroke-width="5"/>';
else if(t==='Chinese landscapes'||t.includes('Edo'))shape='<path d="M12 105Q52 22 82 78L125 23 174 100 209 48 268 108" fill="#38587e" stroke="#74d7ff" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M20 114Q83 79 135 112T270 112" stroke="#80edbe" stroke-width="5"/><circle cx="222" cy="30" r="13" fill="#b7a2ff"/>';
else if(g.medium==='Sculpture')shape='<path d="M130 35C113 32 104 56 122 69L104 105H167L149 69C166 53 150 30 130 35Z" fill="#b7a2ff" stroke="#74d7ff" stroke-width="4"/><rect x="91" y="104" width="90" height="14" rx="5" fill="#80edbe"/>';
else if(t==='Surrealism')shape='<ellipse cx="137" cy="91" rx="45" ry="10" fill="#293e69"/><path d="M106 49H164L149 85H120Z" fill="#b7a2ff"/><circle cx="88" cy="28" r="18" fill="#80edbe"/><path d="M190 30 170 75 220 50Z" fill="#74d7ff"/>';
else if(t==='Abstract Expressionism')shape='<path d="M36 30Q190 20 215 103Q100 30 49 108Q199 109 236 32M70 25 150 116" stroke="#80edbe" stroke-width="8"/><rect x="105" y="43" width="64" height="45" fill="#b7a2ff" opacity=".8"/>';
else shape='<circle cx="220" cy="30" r="18" fill="#b7a2ff"/><path d="M15 105Q70 40 129 90T270 88" fill="#416b82"/><path d="M14 112Q90 86 150 115T270 104" stroke="#80edbe" stroke-width="9"/><path d="M59 64 73 49M88 57 102 42M123 79 138 64M191 99 206 84" stroke="#74d7ff" stroke-width="5"/>';
return `<svg class="illustration" viewBox="0 0 280 140" role="img" aria-label="Original teaching diagram, not a reproduction of a named work"><rect x="3" y="3" width="274" height="134" rx="20" fill="#0c1732" stroke="#405989"/>${shape}<circle cx="252" cy="117" r="4" fill="#80edbe"/></svg>`}
/* Gallery trail: a board-game journey with themes, like the Atlas globe trail. */
let trailStop=null,trailRoom=false;
const TRAIL_THEMES={
 style:{name:'Style trail',pick:'Choose your art style',desc:'Travel through the great styles, from Gothic arches to Abstract Expressionism.',ill:()=>pxArt('styletrail','Pixel-art trail winding past an arch, mountains and a pyramid')},
 museum:{name:'Museum trail',pick:'Choose your museum',desc:'Roll through learning rooms of three famous museums. Each stop is a real artwork and one question.',ill:()=>museumArt('louvre')},
 world:{name:'Around the world',pick:'Art from many lands',desc:'Hop between the lands the art comes from: Egypt, China, Japan, Benin, the Pacific and more.',ill:()=>worldArt()}
};
function trailStops(theme){
 if(theme==='museum'){let out=[];const add=(m,i)=>out.push({kind:'room',mid:m.id,room:i,name:(m.id==='met'?'The Met':m.name)+': '+m.rooms[i].name});museums.forEach(m=>[0,1,2].forEach(i=>add(m,i)));museums.forEach(m=>{for(let i=5;i<m.rooms.length;i+=5)add(m,i)});return out}
 if(theme==='world')return [['Egypt',[21]],['Greece & Rome',[22,23]],['China',[4]],['Japan',[10]],['South Asia',[24,30,31]],['Iran & beyond',[3]],['West Africa',[5,28]],['Mexico & Central America',[26]],['Pacific islands',[27]],['United States',[20]]].map(([name,gids])=>({kind:'land',name,gids}));
 return galleries.map(g=>({kind:'style',gid:g.id,name:g.name}))
}
function trailDone(theme,i){let st=state.trail;return !!(st&&st.theme===theme&&st.done.includes(i))}
function trailMarkDone(i){let st=state.trail;if(!st)return;if(!st.done.includes(i)){st.done.push(i);save()}}
function trailPos(theme){let st=state.trail;return st&&st.theme===theme?st.pos:0}
function trailSyncMuseum(){let st=state.trail;if(!st||st.theme!=='museum')return;trailStops('museum').forEach((sp,i)=>{if((state.rooms||[]).includes(sp.mid+'-'+sp.room)&&!st.done.includes(i)){st.done.push(i)}});save()}
function worldArt(){return pxArt('world','Pixel-art globe with art treasures from around the world')}
function diceSvg(n){const P={1:[[50,50]],2:[[28,28],[72,72]],3:[[24,24],[50,50],[76,76]],4:[[28,28],[72,28],[28,72],[72,72]],5:[[28,28],[72,28],[50,50],[28,72],[72,72]],6:[[28,24],[72,24],[28,50],[72,50],[28,76],[72,76]]}[n]||[];return `<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="46" height="46" role="img" aria-label="Dice showing ${n}"><rect x="5" y="5" width="90" height="90" rx="18" fill="#0c1732" stroke="#80edbe" stroke-width="5"/>${P.map(([x,y])=>`<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="9" fill="#74d7ff"/>`).join('')}</svg>`}
function tickSvg(){return `<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 11 9 16 16 5" stroke="#80edbe" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>`}
function medalSvg(){return `<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="72" height="72" role="img" aria-label="Discovery medal"><circle cx="50" cy="58" r="26" fill="#253a66" stroke="#80edbe" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M50 44 55 55 67 56 58 64 61 76 50 69 39 76 42 64 33 56 45 55Z" fill="#b7a2ff"/><path d="M38 34 30 10M62 34 70 10" stroke="#74d7ff" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>`}
function trailThemes(){route='trail';shell(`<div class="eyebrow">Gallery trail</div><h1>Choose your trail</h1><p class="muted">A board-game journey: roll the dice, visit each stop and clear its challenge. Pick a theme to start or continue.</p>${nav()}<div class="grid">${Object.keys(TRAIL_THEMES).map(k=>{let t=TRAIL_THEMES[k],st=state.trail&&state.trail.theme===k?state.trail:null;return `<button class="card trail-card" data-theme="${k}">${t.ill()}<h2>${t.name}</h2><p class="muted">${t.desc}</p><span class="tag">${t.pick}</span>${st?`<p class="muted">Stop ${st.pos+1} of ${trailStops(k).length} \u00b7 ${st.done.length} cleared</p>`:''}</button>`}).join('')}</div>`);document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let k=b.dataset.theme;if(!state.trail||state.trail.theme!==k){state.trail={theme:k,pos:0,done:[]};save()}trailBoard()})}
function trailBoard(){route='trail';let theme=state.trail?state.trail.theme:'style',stops=trailStops(theme),t=TRAIL_THEMES[theme],pos=trailPos(theme),last=stops.length-1,doneCount=stops.filter((_,i)=>trailDone(theme,i)).length,complete=doneCount===stops.length;let tiles=stops.map((sp,i)=>{let done=trailDone(theme,i),cur=i===pos,open=i<=pos;return `<button class="trail-tile ${done?'done':''} ${cur?'current':''}" data-stop="${i}" ${open?'':'disabled'}><span class="tt-n">${done?tickSvg():(cur?'':i+1)}</span>${cur?`<span class="tt-pawn">${paPawn()}</span>`:''}</button>`}).join('');
 shell(`<div class="eyebrow">${t.name}</div><h1>${complete?'Trail complete!':'Roll. Land. Discover.'}</h1><p class="muted">${t.desc}</p>${nav()}<div class="card trail-status"><div>${diceSvg(state.trail.lastRoll||6)}</div><div class="trail-status-text"><b>Stop ${pos+1} of ${stops.length}</b><p class="muted">${doneCount} of ${stops.length} challenges cleared${pos>=last&&!complete?' · End of the trail - clear the stops you passed':''}</p><div class="buttons"><button class="primary" id="roll" ${complete?'disabled':''}>Roll the dice</button><button data-route="home">Home</button></div></div></div><div class="trail-board">${tiles}</div><p class="muted">Rolling moves your guide along the board. Tap any stop you have reached to take its challenge. Cleared stops show a tick.</p><footer>Original board layout. Challenges are the same gallery and museum room games.</footer>`);
 $('#roll').onclick=()=>{let n=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*6);state.trail.lastRoll=n;state.trail.pos=Math.min(pos+n,last);save();trailBoard();let np=state.trail.pos;if(!trailDone(theme,np))trailStopPrompt(stops[np],np)};
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-stop]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let i=+b.dataset.stop;if(i<=pos&&!trailDone(theme,i))trailStopPrompt(stops[i],i)})}
function trailStopPrompt(sp,i){let label=sp.kind==='room'?sp.name:sp.kind==='land'?('Art from '+sp.name):sp.name;shell(`<div class="card" style="text-align:center">${medalSvg()}<div class="eyebrow">Stop ${i+1}</div><h1>${E(label)}</h1><p>Clear this stop's challenge to mark it on your trail.</p><div class="buttons"><button class="primary" id="trailGo">Take the challenge</button><button id="trailBack">Back to the board</button></div></div>`);$('#trailBack').onclick=trailBoard;$('#trailGo').onclick=()=>{if(sp.kind==='room'){trailRoom=true;museum=museums.find(m=>m.id===sp.mid);roomIndex=sp.room;roomView()}else{trailStop=i;startRound('gallery',sp.kind==='land'?sp.gids.find(g=>!state.badges.includes(g))??sp.gids[0]:sp.gid)}}}
/* Clue ladder: broad-to-specific clues, 30s, value drops 1 every 6s. Round = 10 questions. */
let ladderTimer=null,ladder=null;
const LADDER_TOPICS={style:'Art style',artwork:'Artwork',artist:'Artist',museum:'Museum'};
const MUSEUM_DISTRACTORS=['The British Museum','Prado Museum','Uffizi Galleries','Vatican Museums',"Mus\u00e9e d'Orsay",'MoMA'];
function ladderClears(t){return (state.ladder&&state.ladder.clears&&state.ladder.clears[t])||0}
function ladderUnlocked(mode,t){return mode==='choice'||ladderClears(t)>=3}
function ladderSaveClear(t,pts,correct){state.ladder=state.ladder||{clears:{},best:{}};let before=ladderClears(t);if(correct>=8)state.ladder.clears[t]=before+1;state.ladder.best[t]=Math.max(state.ladder.best[t]||0,pts);save();return correct>=8&&before<3&&state.ladder.clears[t]>=3}
function ladderDecade(d){let m=String(d).match(/(\d{3,4})/);return m?Math.floor(+m[1]/10)*10+'s':null}
function ladderAliases(name){let out=[name];name.split(/\s*[\/\u2013(]/).forEach(p=>{p=p.trim();if(p.length>2)out.push(p)});return out}
function ladderNorm(x){return String(x).toLowerCase().replace(/^the\s+/,'').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,' ').trim()}
function ladderShuffle(a){a=a.slice();for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){let j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a}
function ladderGen(topic){
 let pool=[];
 if(topic==='style'){pool=ladderShuffle(galleries).slice(0,10).map(g=>{
  let clues=[`A ${g.medium.toLowerCase()} tradition from ${g.region}.`,`Dates: about ${g.dates}.`,`Look for: ${g.traits[0]}.`,g.traits[1]?`Also: ${g.traits[1]}.`:`Example: ${g.example}.`,g.story.split('. ')[0]+'.'];
  return {answer:g.name,accept:ladderAliases(g.name),clues,options:ladderShuffle([g.name,...ladderShuffle(galleries.filter(x=>x.id!==g.id)).slice(0,5).map(x=>x.name)])}})}
 if(topic==='artwork'){pool=ladderShuffle(artworks).slice(0,10).map(w=>{
  let dec=ladderDecade(w.date),words=w.title.split(' ').length;
  let clues=['A public-domain work in The Met\'s collection.',dec?`Made in the ${dec}.`:`A historic work, date recorded as ${w.date}.`,w.artist==='Maker not recorded'?'The maker is not recorded.':`By ${w.artist}.`,`The title has ${words} word${words>1?'s':''} and starts with \u201c${w.title.split(' ')[0]}\u2026\u201d`,{img:w.img,alt:w.title}];
  return {answer:w.title,accept:ladderAliases(w.title),clues,options:ladderShuffle([w.title,...ladderShuffle(artworks.filter(x=>x.id!==w.id)).slice(0,5).map(x=>x.title)])}})}
 if(topic==='artist'){let named=artworks.filter(w=>w.artist!=='Maker not recorded');
  pool=ladderShuffle(named).slice(0,10).map(w=>{let a=w.artist,dec=ladderDecade(w.date),others=named.filter(x=>x.artist!==a);
  let clues=['An artist whose work is in The Met\'s collection.',dec?`Active around the ${dec}.`:'Dates are not precisely recorded.',`One work: \u201c${w.title}\u201d.`,`That work is dated ${w.date}.`,{img:w.img,alt:w.title}];
  return {answer:a,accept:ladderAliases(a),clues,options:ladderShuffle([a,...ladderShuffle(others).slice(0,5).map(x=>x.artist)])}})}
 if(topic==='museum'){pool=ladderShuffle([0,1,2,0,1,2,0,1,2,0]).map((mi,i)=>{let m=museums[mi],r=ladderShuffle(m.rooms);
  let clues=['One of the world\'s famous museums.',`You find it in ${m.city}.`,`One artwork in its learning rooms: \u201c${r[0].title}\u201d.`,`Another artwork: \u201c${r[1].title}\u201d.`,m.note.split('. ')[0]+'.'];
  return {answer:m.name,accept:ladderAliases(m.name),clues,options:ladderShuffle([m.name,...ladderShuffle(museums.filter(x=>x.id!==m.id)).map(x=>x.name),...ladderShuffle(MUSEUM_DISTRACTORS).slice(0,3)])}})}
 return pool}
function ladderSetup(){route='play';shell(`<div class="eyebrow">Clue ladder</div><h1>Five clues, fading points</h1><p class="muted">Each question starts broad and gets easier with every clue. You have 30 seconds: answer fast for 5 points, because the value drops by 1 every 6 seconds. A round is 10 questions.</p>${nav()}<div class="card"><h2>1. Pick a topic</h2><div class="buttons four" id="ladderTopic">${Object.keys(LADDER_TOPICS).map(t=>`<button data-lt="${t}" class="${ladder&&ladder.topic===t?'selected':''}">${LADDER_TOPICS[t]}</button>`).join('')}</div><h2>2. Pick a mode</h2><div class="buttons"><button data-lm="choice" class="${ladder&&ladder.mode==='choice'?'selected':''}">6 choices</button><button data-lm="typing" id="ladderTyping">Type the answer <span class="tag">harder</span></button></div><p class="muted" id="ladderLock"></p><button class="primary" id="ladderStart">Start round</button></div>`);
 let topic=(ladder&&ladder.topic)||'style',mode=(ladder&&ladder.mode)||'choice',tp=!!(ladder&&ladder.topic),mp=!!(ladder&&ladder.mode);
 const paint=()=>{if(mode==='typing'&&!ladderUnlocked('typing',topic))mode='choice';document.querySelectorAll('[data-lt]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('selected',tp&&b.dataset.lt===topic));document.querySelectorAll('[data-lm]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('selected',mp&&b.dataset.lm===mode));$('#ladderStart').disabled=!(tp&&mp);let tb=$('#ladderTyping');tb.disabled=!tp||!ladderUnlocked('typing',topic);$('#ladderLock').textContent=!tp?'Pick a topic and a mode to start. Typing unlocks per topic after 3 clears of the 6-choice mode.':ladderUnlocked('typing',topic)?`Typing unlocked for ${LADDER_TOPICS[topic]}. Clears so far: ${ladderClears(topic)}.`:`Typing unlocks after you clear the 6-choice mode 3 times on ${LADDER_TOPICS[topic]} (${ladderClears(topic)}/3, clear = 8+ correct).`};
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-lt]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{tp=true;topic=b.dataset.lt;paint()});
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-lm]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{mp=true;mode=b.dataset.lm;paint()});
 paint();
 $('#ladderStart').onclick=()=>{ladder={topic,mode,qs:ladderGen(topic),i:0,points:0,correct:0};ladderQuestion()}}
function ladderQuestion(){let L=ladder;if(L.i>=L.qs.length)return ladderResult();let q=L.qs[L.i],t0=Date.now(),shown=1,answered=false;
 shell(`<div class="quiz"><div class="row"><span class="tag">Question ${L.i+1} / ${L.qs.length}</span><span class="tag" id="ladderWorth">Worth 5 pts</span></div><div class="track"><i id="ladderBar" style="width:100%"></i></div><div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Clue ladder \u00b7 ${LADDER_TOPICS[L.topic]} \u00b7 ${L.mode==='choice'?'6 choices':'Type the answer'}</div><ol class="ladder-clues" id="ladderClues"><li>${typeof q.clues[0]==='string'?E(q.clues[0]):''}</li></ol><div id="ladderImg"></div>${L.mode==='choice'?`<div id="answers">${q.options.map(o=>`<button class="choice visual-answer" data-lopt="${E(o)}"><span>${E(o)}</span></button>`).join('')}</div>`:`<div class="buttons" style="margin-top:10px"><input id="ladderInput" placeholder="Type your answer" autocomplete="off"><button class="primary" id="ladderSubmit">Guess</button></div>`}<div id="feedback" aria-live="polite"></div></div></div>`);
 const val=()=>Math.max(1,5-Math.floor((Date.now()-t0)/6000));
 const tick=()=>{let el=(Date.now()-t0)/1000;if(el>=30){finish(null);return}
  $('#ladderBar').style.width=(100-el/30*100)+'%';
  let v=val();$('#ladderWorth').textContent=`Worth ${v} pt${v>1?'s':''}`;
  let idx=Math.min(4,Math.floor(el/6));
  if(idx+1>shown){shown=idx+1;let c=q.clues[idx];
   if(typeof c==='string'){let li=document.createElement('li');li.textContent=c;$('#ladderClues').appendChild(li)}
   else{$('#ladderImg').innerHTML=`<figure class="quiz-art"><img src="${c.img}" alt="${E(c.alt)}"/></figure>`}}};
 const finish=(picked)=>{if(answered)return;answered=true;clearInterval(ladderTimer);ladderTimer=null;
  let ok=picked!=null&&(L.mode==='choice'?picked===q.answer:ladderAliases(q.answer).some(a=>ladderNorm(a)===ladderNorm(picked)));
  let pts=ok?val():0;ladder.points+=pts;if(ok)ladder.correct++;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-lopt]').forEach(b=>{b.disabled=true;if(b.dataset.lopt===q.answer)b.classList.add('correct');else if(picked&&b.dataset.lopt===picked)b.classList.add('wrong')});
  let inp=$('#ladderInput');if(inp)inp.disabled=true;let sb=$('#ladderSubmit');if(sb)sb.disabled=true;
  $('#feedback').innerHTML=`<div class="feedback ${ok?'':'error'}"><h3>${ok?`Correct! +${pts} pts`:picked==null?'Time up!':'Not this time'}</h3><p>The answer: <b>${E(q.answer)}</b>.</p><button class="primary choice" id="ladderNext">${L.i===L.qs.length-1?'See my score':'Next question \u2192'}</button></div>`;
  $('#ladderNext').onclick=()=>{ladder.i++;ladderQuestion()}};
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-lopt]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>finish(b.dataset.lopt));
 let sb=$('#ladderSubmit');if(sb){sb.onclick=()=>finish($('#ladderInput').value);$('#ladderInput').onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')finish(e.target.value)}}
 ladderTimer=setInterval(tick,250)}
function ladderResult(){let L=ladder,unlocked=ladderSaveClear(L.topic,L.points,L.correct),clears=ladderClears(L.topic);
 shell(`<div class="card" style="text-align:center">${L.correct>=8?medalSvg():''}<div class="eyebrow">${L.correct>=8?'Round complete':'Round finished'}</div><h1>${L.points} points</h1><h2>${L.correct} / ${L.qs.length} correct</h2><p>${L.correct>=8?'Round cleared!':'Clear a round with 8 or more correct.'} ${L.mode==='choice'?`Choice clears on ${LADDER_TOPICS[L.topic]}: ${Math.min(clears,3)} / 3.`:`Best on this topic: ${(state.ladder.best||{})[L.topic]||L.points} pts.`}</p>${unlocked?`<p class="tag">Typing mode unlocked for ${LADDER_TOPICS[L.topic]}!</p>`:''}<div class="buttons"><button class="primary" id="ladderAgain">Play again</button><button id="ladderSetupBtn">Change topic or mode</button></div></div>`);
 $('#ladderAgain').onclick=()=>{ladder={topic:L.topic,mode:L.mode,qs:ladderGen(L.topic),i:0,points:0,correct:0};ladderQuestion()};
 $('#ladderSetupBtn').onclick=ladderSetup}
function nav(){return ''}
let navStack=[],navRestore=false;
function shell(html){
 const fn=shell.caller;
 if(!navRestore&&fn){const last=navStack[navStack.length-1];if(!last||last.fn!==fn){navStack.push({fn,args:Array.from(fn.arguments||[])});if(navStack.length>30)navStack.shift()}}
 navRestore=false;
 if(typeof ladderTimer!=='undefined'&&ladderTimer){clearInterval(ladderTimer);ladderTimer=null}
 const showBack=navStack.length>1;
 $('#app').innerHTML=(showBack?'<button class="ghost back-btn" id="backBtn" aria-label="Back to previous screen">← Back</button>':'')+html;
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-route]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>go(b.dataset.route));
 if(showBack)$('#backBtn').onclick=navBack;
 window.scrollTo(0,0)}
function navBack(){
 navStack.pop();
 while(navStack.length){const top=navStack[navStack.length-1];
  if(top.fn===question||top.fn===result){navStack.pop();continue}
  navRestore=true;
  try{top.fn.apply(null,top.args||[])}catch(e){navRestore=false;navStack=[];go('home')}
  return}
 go('home')}
function go(r){route=r;if(r==='explore'){state.mode='free';save()}if(r==='trail'){state.mode='journey';save()}if(r==='home')home();if(r==='explore')explore();if(r==='play')playMenu();if(r==='collection')collection();if(r==='shops')shops();if(r==='museums')museumSelector();if(r==='trail')trailThemes()}
function home(){shell(`<section class="hero compact"><div><div class="eyebrow">Neon Art Gallery</div><h1>A world of art.<br>A game of discovery.</h1></div><div>${curator()}</div></section><div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">1. Let's play</div><div class="home-choices"><button data-route="explore"><b style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px"><svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" shape-rendering="crispEdges" aria-hidden="true"
